failures.criterion: The tests this PR adds pass reliably in the required race lane: TestTheStoredRowsOfARoomFoldToItsDocumentWhenAPeerUpdateParks (221f3ce3) runs in envoy-go-race-docs.
failures.evidence: cd packages/envoy && DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<postgres> CGO_ENABLED=1 GOMAXPROCS=4 go test -race -p 2 -parallel 4 ./internal/dispatch/docs -count=10 -run '^(TestARefusedPeerUpdateLeavesTheRoomAsItsOtherPeersHoldIt|TestTheStoredRowsOfARoomFoldToItsDocumentWhenAPeerUpdateParks)$' : 4 failures of the Parked test in 190 runs (2/10, 0/20, 0/30, 1/60, 1/70 of a probe copy), each 'parked_peer_update_test.go:61: once the first keystroke landed: the room's state vector is map[1302262099:2 1612693470:15 3757806369:8] but its stored rows fold to map[1612693470:15 3757806369:8]'. A throwaway probe reloaded the stored rows 300 ms after a mismatch: they then held the missing client (clock 2, versions 2), a server write of the test service's 20 ms settlement (newTestService Settle). requireStoredRowsFoldToTheRoom loads the stored rows, then reads the room's state vector; a settlement landing between them makes them differ. The product held; the test races a concurrent settlement. Remedy: service.settle = time.Hour in this test, as the package's other room tests set it, or compare against a stable room (state vector read before and after the load, retried until both agree). No new red test: the flaky test is itself the reproduction (command above).
